card.name: Polish and diacritic letters in names
card.fires_on: Accented non-English letters such as ł, ś, ć, ğ inside foreign proper names or transliterated terms, especially Polish names. Also fires on garbled-quote characters in web text.

modes.label: Polish ł in names
modes.description: The letter ł inside a Polish place or personal name.

modes.label: ś and Ś in transliterations
modes.description: The letter ś or Ś in Sanskrit terms or in text with broken quote marks.

modes.label: Name-final ć or ğ
modes.description: A Balkan or Turkish accented letter ending or sitting inside a surname.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward continuing a word with more letters after a rare accented character.
card.plain: It lights up on unusual accented letters inside foreign names, mostly Polish ones.
